specialistReviews.finding: Static source code equality does not establish provider webhook signature validation, effective PostgreSQL browser grants, or safe untrusted email handling.
specialistReviews.resolution: Limit completion scope to canonical source; require real Postgres RLS/GRANT, worker signature, actor binding and untrusted email behavior checks before deployment.

specialistReviews.finding: Composite (thread_id,instance_id) FK requires 0050 Office thread index and existing customer thread schema.
specialistReviews.resolution: Verify 0050 predecessor and full canonical 0054 FK/backfill/RFC idempotency source statements.

specialistReviews.finding: Inbound mailbox schema and routing are high-risk database scope; merging quality runtime or provider integration would exceed budget.
specialistReviews.resolution: SQL+manifest+neutral tests only; Release Risk <=5/5 exact previous head; no CI/push Preview before dependency closure.

specialistReviews.finding: Production inbound MX/domain and active staging must not be modified to prove a source migration.

challenge.scenario: A buyer-support thread exists for tenant A and guessed thread UUID is used from tenant B.
challenge.finding: An inbound route may forward mail to an unrelated tenant if the composite FK is lost.
challenge.resolution: Require route table foreign key(thread_id,instance_id) to same instance Office thread, and isolated real tenant proof.

challenge.scenario: An authenticated user queries office_thread_email_routes through Data API.
challenge.finding: Reply_token routing secret or private inbound mailbox address could be leaked.
challenge.resolution: Preserve RLS on both new tables and explicit revoke all from public,anon,authenticated; verify effective grants in real Postgres later.

challenge.scenario: An attacker sends fake inbound email body containing instructions to perform store operations.
challenge.finding: Untrusted email content could be executed as business actions by downstream workers.
challenge.resolution: Preserve data-only storage contract and defer provider webhook signature/agent safeguards to dedicated capability proof.

challenge.scenario: A duplicate RFC Message-ID is replayed by the provider.
challenge.finding: Duplicate customer messages or cross-thread correlation could result without canonical record_inbound_v3 guard.
challenge.resolution: Preserve complete canonical inbound RPC and RFC index, test source and require real idempotency rehearsal.

challenge.scenario: An internal private Team Chat message acquires a routable external mailbox token.
challenge.finding: Private staff conversation content may become addressable through public reply route.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical conversation_type customer filter in route synchronization and backfill.

challenge.scenario: A mailbox is marked active before external provider DNS/domain is verified.
challenge.finding: Live inbound traffic might be misrouted or lost, and tenant onboarding becomes partially enabled.
challenge.resolution: No external provider actions, preserve is_active default false, require later rollout gate.

challenge.scenario: A 0054 migration includes only table creation but omits trigger or GRANT revocation.
challenge.finding: Static function markers appear present while runtime remains unsafe or broken.
challenge.resolution: Require full body SHA256 equality with main canonical SQL and focused RLS/route contract tests.

challenge.scenario: The manifest is marked ready immediately after 0054 even though mailbox normalization/Advanced Office are absent.
challenge.finding: Incomplete product capability is overclaimed and may trigger risky deployment.
challenge.resolution: Keep snapshot-reviewed, null proof hash, and block completion until ordered 0055+ plus disposable Fresh Install acceptance.
